results.content: Jul 3, 2026 · Reco12 is an open-to-all addictions and afflictions organization, dedicated to exploring the common threads of the differing manifestations of alcoholism; sharing tools, and offering hope from those walking a similar path. We gather from diverse backgrounds, faiths, and locations to learn and support one another. RECO12 is a recovery focused podcast built around the idea that while addictions may take many different forms, the principles that lead people toward healing often share remarkable similarities.
